daily_summary: JPMorgan AI Chief and top trader exits after four decades. - JPMorgan's Teresa Heitsenrether to retire; Scot Baldry to lead CDAO. - JPMorgan backs US crypto rules, warns on shadow banking risks. - JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon criticizes emerging tech regulation bill. - Softbank in talks for $10B loan including JPMorgan as lender. - Cboe seeks to list options on JPMorgan's credit-loss provisions.
